summary: A marketplace website for GreenPlantz connecting garden nursery vendors with customers. Vendors can register, manage products with pricing in rupees, upload photos with automatic watermarking, and fulfill orders. Admin team can manage orders, assign vendors based on location/pincode and product availability, handle payments and shipping details, control vendor access (enable/disable/delete), manage individual product visibility, and configure vendor commission rates.
architectural_notes: Two-sided marketplace: vendor portal and admin portal with separate authentication
Image processing pipeline for watermark detection and application
Location-based vendor matching using pincode/address data
Admin has full control over vendor access and product visibility
Commission structure configurable per vendor (percentage or fixed amount)
Order assignment algorithm considers both product availability and location proximity
Admin team member management with position and individual authentication
SKU generation logic: unique per vendor-product combination, reused for identical products from same vendor
